name: 3D Avatar Emoji
summary: A rendered 3D head, an animal or a user cartoon, that copies the face of the user in real time. Apple showed Animoji with the iPhone X in 2017, and Memoji followed in 2018.

philosophy.core_thesis: The emoji copies the face of the sender: a mask with a voice, not a fixed picture.
design_principles: Render a round head with a 1:1 ratio, a diameter of 120px to 240px, and soft studio light from the top left.
Use a clay-like surface with a roughness of 0.6 and no visible texture; keep colours flat and bright.
Make the eyes 12% of the head width, glossy, with one 4px highlight at the top right.
Copy the face of the user at 60 fps: eyebrows, eyelids, jaw and mouth corners map to the head.
Cast a soft contact shadow of 24px blur at 18% opacity under the head on a pale violet ground.
Offer the head in a grid of 4 columns with 16px gutters and a record button of 64px at the base.
Limit a recorded clip to 10 seconds and export it at 30 fps.
anti_patterns: Realistic skin pores and photographic light
A fixed pose with no face tracking

layout.grid_mechanics: A picker grid of 4 columns with 16px gutters; the live head sits in a 1:1 frame at the top, with the controls at the base.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35% to 45% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 40px.
layout.alignment_rules: The head is centred in its frame; controls are centred at the base with a 24px gap.
layout.container_geometry: Cards and the record button with a 24px radius or a full circle; the head sits in a circle or a squircle.

font_pairings.note: A round geometric face echoes the soft forms of the head.
A warmer rounded face for a sticker-like pack.

hierarchy_rules: Set the display line at 32px to 48px in 700 weight.
Keep body text at 16px and labels at 12px in 600 weight.
Let the head be the largest element on the screen.

color.palette_structure: A pale violet field with one violet and one orange; the head supplies bright, flat colour.
color.contrast_rules: Deep indigo on lilac holds 15:1; violet and orange fill shapes and buttons, with indigo or white text as the contrast needs.
color.surface_treatment: Smooth flat fields; the head carries the depth and the soft light.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft top-left key light and a faint rim light; a contact shadow of 24px blur at 18% opacity.

materiality.surface_simulation: Soft clay or vinyl: matte, smooth, with a small gloss on the eyes.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px mist line on cards; no line on the head.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 24px soft shadow at 18% under cards and the head.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Duotone glyphs at 24px in a circle of 40px.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Rendered heads of animals, robots and user-made people with 3 to 6 accessories.

motion.transition_physics: The head follows the face at 60 fps with a 40ms lag; a pick swaps the head with a 350ms squash and stretch of 8%.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts a card by 4px; active scales the head to 0.95 and records.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels playful, personal and a little amused at a mask that copies their face.

use_cases: friendly onboarding with a talking mascot
avoid_when: The device has no depth camera or face tracking.
The brand needs a formal tone.
The user cannot show the face, for privacy reasons.

modifiers.how: Replace the rendered head with a flat yellow face and drop the contact shadow.
Draw a 3px outline, add a white cut-out edge and a short word.
Add textured materials, a harder light and visible depth on every control.

pack.why: A duotone family gives each glyph a soft second tone like the rendered heads.

ground.why: A rendered head floats in a soft lit space, so the ground shows blurred, lit spheres.
